messages:
Devon: quick pass on high-contrast mode + shortcuts overlay accessibility. a few behavior and copy issues i want to capture. :mag:
Priya: good call. what did you find?
Devon: short list:
- overlay opens with semi-transparent backdrop in HC; we didn't set aria-hidden on the rest of the app so SR hears background content.
- icon-only shortcut buttons (e.g., toggle dev toolbar) have empty title and no aria-label -> NVDA says just "button".
- close button reads "Dismiss" because of wrong i18n key. should be contextual "Close keyboard shortcuts".
- keycap token contrast in HC fails (white on #f2f2f2 ~= 2.6:1).
- focus trap: shift+tab from first focusable doesn't return to trigger (Cmd+/) -> keyboard users can be trapped.
Ava: repro steps? i can run VoiceOver.
Devon: repro: enable HC in profile -> press Cmd+/ -> try shift+tab on first item. overlay has <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true"> but we forgot aria-hidden on #app-content. aria-bot: note that aria-modal doesn't block SR in all browsers; siblings should be aria-hidden when dialog open.
aria-bot: recommendation: set aria-hidden="true" on main app wrapper when overlay is open; ensure focus trap returns focus to trigger on close.
Priya: for copy: change visible heading to "Keyboard shortcuts" and close button aria-label to "Close keyboard shortcuts". icon-only buttons must have aria-labels like "Toggle developer toolbar". add aria-describedby linking to the summary paragraph.
contrast-bot: auto-check: keycap token (white / #f2f2f2) -> 2.62:1 (fail AA). suggestions: keycap-bg #e2e2e2 or keycap-text #111827 to hit 4.5:1.
QA-Miguel: i'll add this to HC test matrix. can we list acceptance criteria?
Devon: acceptance criteria for PR:
- #app-content gets aria-hidden="true" when overlay open and removed on close
- dialog has role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Keyboard shortcuts"
- close button aria-label="Close keyboard shortcuts"
- icon-only buttons include explicit aria-labels
- keycap token updated to meet 4.5:1 in HC theme
- focus trap moves shift+tab back to the overlay trigger; ESC closes overlay
Priya: i'll update strings and token suggestions in a small PR. Devon/Ava can do the aria-hidden + focus trap.
Ava: i'll take focus trap + aria-hidden. will keep changes minimal so we can ship fast.
QA-Miguel: once PRs are up i'll run VoiceOver, NVDA, keyboard-only flows, and attach contrast screenshots.
Devon: also telemetry note: when overlay opens we log ui.shortcuts.open with a flag for HC active. ensure payload has no PII.
Priya: noted. small follow-up: check translations for the close key so other locales don't fall back to "Dismiss".
Ava: thanks team. i'll open a PR and tag reviewers.
Priya: will open the copy/token PR.
QA-Miguel: ready to test after PRs. thanks! :white_check_mark:
